description:
Keep a private record of the places you visit and the routes you travel. Whereday helps you review a day on a map, browse your location timeline, and count days spent in each country.

YOUR LOCATION JOURNAL
• Record visits and GPS routes
• Review outings and photos on the map
• Add manual visits and correct saved visit times
• Record routes on Apple Watch and sync them to your iPhone
• Export saved history as JSON, CSV, Markdown, GPX, or KML

ACCESS FOR NEW USERS
If you first get Whereday with this subscription update or later, choose an Individual or Family plan before starting to track. Weekly and yearly subscriptions include a 7-day free trial for eligible Apple Accounts. Starting a trial requires confirming the subscription with Apple. After the trial, your selected plan renews automatically at the price and billing interval shown before confirmation, unless canceled. Lifetime is a separate one-time purchase with no subscription trial. There is no monthly plan.

EXISTING USERS KEEP THEIR ACCESS
If you first got Whereday before this update, you keep free tracking. Existing free users still need an export purchase to unlock export features. All previous lifetime purchases remain valid, including Family Sharing on the original lifetime unlock. You do not need to subscribe to keep your existing tracking access or lifetime purchase.

YOUR RECORDS AFTER A SUBSCRIPTION ENDS
Users who joined under the subscription model can still view and export existing records after their trial or subscription expires. Starting new tracking or adding a manual visit requires active access. Ending a subscription does not delete your records.

FAMILY AND PURCHASE SETTINGS
Family plans support Apple Family Sharing with up to five other family members, subject to Apple's eligibility and sharing settings. Individual plans are not shared. Prices, currencies, trial eligibility, and renewal terms are shown by the App Store before you confirm. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before renewal. Restore purchases in Whereday using the Apple Account associated with your access.

Your location history stays on your device. No Whereday account is required for tracking. Apple purchases, Maps services, optional exports, and limited technical services have the network behavior described in our privacy policy.

Privacy Policy: https://whereday.com/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://whereday.com/terms
